$comment: Board database for the coord skill. Collections: tasks, lanes; single doc meta/state. Rows are REPORTED, NOT VERIFIED: git is the truth; coord reconciles. Write with one ArtifactData batch per event, each entry pinned with if_version.

fields.name: string - display name, e.g. 'Platform' or 'Backlog - after the milestone'
fields.session: string - session name, e.g. proj-api (empty for backlog)

tasks.doc_id: slice id, e.g. PL3 or BL12 for backlog

fields.title: string
fields.status: enum: todo | wip | ready | blocked | landed | deployed
fields.mergedAs: string - integration merge sha (set by coord only)
fields.decisionRefs: string - ids in the amendments/plan docs; never the decision text

state.integrationSha: string - after the last pushed batch
state.milestone: string - name and date of the next milestone
